# Array generation

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.swift from the Quiver 1.6.0 public API. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every API below exists in Quiver 1.0.0 and later unless it is tagged *(since X)*. Each entry is the declaration, then the first line of its documentation.

## Array extensions where Element: Numeric

- `static func zeros(_ count: Int) -> [Element]` — Creates a 1D array filled with zeros. Returns: An array of the specified length with all elements set to zero
- `static func ones(_ count: Int) -> [Element]` — Creates a 1D array filled with ones. Returns: An array of the specified length with all elements set to one
- `static func full(_ count: Int, value: Element) -> [Element]` — Creates a 1D array filled with a specific value. Returns: An array of the specified length with all elements set to the given value
- `static func zeros(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int) -> [[Element]]` — Creates a 2D array filled with zeros. Returns: A matrix of the specified dimensions with all elements set to zero
- `static func ones(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int) -> [[Element]]` — Creates a 2D array filled with ones. Returns: A matrix of the specified dimensions with all elements set to one
- `static func full(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, value: Element) -> [[Element]]` — Creates a 2D array filled with a specific value. Returns: A matrix of the specified dimensions with all elements set to the given value
- `static func identity(_ n: Int) -> [[Element]]` — Creates an identity matrix of size n × n. Returns: An n × n identity matrix
- `static func diag(_ diagonal: [Element]) -> [[Element]]` — Creates a diagonal matrix from a vector of diagonal values. Returns: Square matrix with diagonal values from input vector, zeros elsewhere
- `static func arange(_ start: Element, _ stop: Element, step: Element) -> [Element] where Element : Comparable` — Creates a sequence of evenly spaced values within a half-open interval. Returns: An array of evenly spaced values from start up to stop

## Array extensions where Element: FloatingPoint

- `static func linspace(start: Element, end: Element, count: Int) -> [Element]` — Creates evenly spaced numbers over a specified closed interval. Returns: An array of `count` evenly spaced values from start to end (inclusive)
- `static func arange(_ start: Element, _ stop: Element, step: Element = 1) -> [Element]` — Creates a sequence of evenly spaced values within a half-open interval. Returns: An array of evenly spaced values from start up to stop

## Array extensions where Element == Double

- `static func sineWave(frequency: Double, sampleRate: Double, count: Int, amplitude: Double = 1.0, offset: Double = 0.0) -> [Double]` — Generates a sine wave signal at a given frequency and sample rate. Returns: An array of `count` samples representing one or more cycles of the sine wave at the specified frequency. *(since 1.1.0)*
- `static func random(_ count: Int) -> [Double]` — Creates a 1D array of random values uniformly distributed between 0 and 1. Returns: An array of uniformly distributed random doubles in [0, 1]
- `static func random<G>(_ count: Int, using generator: inout G) -> [Double] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 1D array of random values uniformly distributed between 0 and 1, drawing from the given generator. Returns: An array of uniformly distributed random doubles in [0, 1] *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func random(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int) -> [[Double]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values uniformly distributed between 0 and 1. Returns: A matrix of uniformly distributed random doubles in [0, 1]
- `static func random<G>(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, using generator: inout G) -> [[Double]] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 2D array of random values uniformly distributed between 0 and 1, drawing from the given generator. Returns: A matrix of uniformly distributed random doubles in [0, 1] *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func random(_ count: Int, in range: ClosedRange<Double>) -> [Double]` — Creates a 1D array of random values uniformly distributed in the given range. Returns: An array of uniformly distributed random doubles within the specified range
- `static func random<G>(_ count: Int, in range: ClosedRange<Double>, using generator: inout G) -> [Double] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 1D array of random values uniformly distributed in the given range, drawing from the given generator. Returns: An array of uniformly distributed random doubles within the specified range *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func random(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, in range: ClosedRange<Double>) -> [[Double]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values uniformly distributed in the given range. Returns: A matrix of uniformly distributed random doubles within the specified range
- `static func random<G>(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, in range: ClosedRange<Double>, using generator: inout G) -> [[Double]] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 2D array of random values uniformly distributed in the given range, drawing from the given generator. - `static func randomNormal(_ count: Int, mean: Double = 0.0, standardDeviation: Double = 1.0) -> [Double]` — Creates a 1D array of random values from a normal (Gaussian) distribution. Returns: An array of normally distributed random doubles *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func randomNormal<G>(_ count: Int, mean: Double = 0.0, standardDeviation: Double = 1.0, using generator: inout G) -> [Double] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 1D array of random values from a normal (Gaussian) distribution, drawing from the given generator. - `static func randomNormal(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, mean: Double = 0.0, standardDeviation: Double = 1.0) -> [[Double]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values from a normal (Gaussian) distribution. Returns: A matrix of normally distributed random doubles *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func randomNormal<G>(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, mean: Double = 0.0, standardDeviation: Double = 1.0, using generator: inout G) -> [[Double]] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 2D array of random values from a normal (Gaussian) distribution, drawing from the given generator. Returns: A matrix of normally distributed random doubles *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func randomExponential(_ count: Int, rate: Double = 1.0) -> [Double]` — Creates a 1D array of random values from an exponential distribution. Returns: An array of exponentially distributed random doubles, all non-negative *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func randomExponential<G>(_ count: Int, rate: Double = 1.0, using generator: inout G) -> [Double] where G : RandomNumberGenerator` — Creates a 1D array of random values from an exponential distribution, drawing from the given generator. Returns: An array of exponentially distributed random doubles *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func randomExponential(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, rate: Double = 1.0) -> [[Double]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values from an exponential distribution. Returns: A matrix of exponentially distributed random doubles *(since 1.2.0)*

Returns: An array of binomial counts as whole-number doubles *(since 1.2.0)*

## Array extensions where Element == Float

- `static func random(_ count: Int) -> [Float]` — Creates a 1D array of random values uniformly distributed between 0 and 1. Returns: An array of uniformly distributed random floats in [0, 1]
- `static func random(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int) -> [[Float]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values uniformly distributed between 0 and 1. Returns: A matrix of uniformly distributed random floats in [0, 1]
- `static func random(_ count: Int, in range: ClosedRange<Float>) -> [Float]` — Creates a 1D array of random values uniformly distributed in the given range. Returns: An array of uniformly distributed random floats within the specified range
- `static func random(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, in range: ClosedRange<Float>) -> [[Float]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values uniformly distributed in the given range. Returns: A matrix of uniformly distributed random floats within the specified range
- `static func randomNormal(_ count: Int, mean: Float = 0.0, standardDeviation: Float = 1.0) -> [Float]` — Creates a 1D array of random values from a normal (Gaussian) distribution. Returns: An array of normally distributed random floats *(since 1.2.0)*
- `static func randomNormal(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, mean: Float = 0.0, standardDeviation: Float = 1.0) -> [[Float]]` — Creates a 2D array of random values from a normal (Gaussian) distribution. Returns: A matrix of normally distributed random floats *(since 1.2.0)*

## Array extensions where Element == Int

- `static func random(_ count: Int, in range: Range<Int>) -> [Int]` — Creates a 1D array of random integers in the given half-open range. Returns: An array of random integers within the specified range
- `static func random(_ rows: Int, _ columns: Int, in range: Range<Int>) -> [[Int]]` — Creates a 2D array of random integers in the given half-open range. Returns: A matrix of random integers within the specified range

## SeededRandomNumberGenerator

`struct SeededRandomNumberGenerator` — A deterministic random number generator that produces the same sequence for a given seed. *(since 1.2.0)*

Conforms to: RandomNumberGenerator.

- `let seed: UInt64` — The seed originally supplied to the generator. *(since 1.2.0)*
- `init(seed: UInt64)` — Creates a generator seeded with the given value. *(since 1.2.0)*
- `mutating func next() -> UInt64` — Returns the next random `UInt64` by scrambling the internal state. *(since 1.2.0)*
